races.name: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
It's hard to get away from SILVER KISS, who built on her strong debut form when third at Galway last time. Likely improver Maeda Matsu looks the chief threat, while Star Glory and Churchill Bond also need considering.

  1. SILVER KISS (IRE)
  2. MAEDA MATSU (IRE)
  3. STAR GLORY (IRE)

races.name: Matchbook Exchange Irish EBF Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
Standard-setter ARGENTARIUS may well make it third time lucky. Interesting newcomer Formous is feared, especially if the market speaks in her favour. Red Primrose's debut form has worked out well, and she also needs considering along with Pink Venom, Film Set and Alfresco.

  1. ARGENTARIUS
  2. FORMOUS (IRE)
  3. RED PRIMROSE (IRE)

races.name: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden
races.verdict:
ZOAR showed enough on debut to suggest a race of this calibre is within reach and his recent stable switch looks noteworthy. The progressive Roeillaun should be on the premises again, with Capital of Pride taken to step up on his debut effort.

  1. ZOAR (USA)
  2. ROEILLAUN (IRE)
  3. CAPITAL OF PRIDE (IRE)

races.name: Tally-Ho Stud Irish EBF Ballyogan Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Group 3)
races.verdict:
FIRST INSTINCT benefited from the return to 6f when runner-up in the Summer Stakes at York last month, the others who made the frame all winning next time out, and she is taken to go one better for her much-respected yard. Three-time course winner Havana Anna is feared most, ahead of Soul Love who beat several of today's rivals here on her latest outing.

  1. FIRST INSTINCT
  2. HAVANA ANNA
  3. SOUL LOVE

races.name: Big Evs At Tally-Ho Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
DANDY LAND arrives on an upward curve after winning over C&D earlier in the month and, with the prospect of further progress, is taken to defy a 7 lb rise. Tawaazon boasts a good record at this course and shaped as if on the way back last time, so is likely to prove the main threat if building on that, while Steel Magnolia, who bounced back when second here last time, and recent Cork second Simmering Seas should also be firmly in the mix.

  1. DANDY LAND (IRE)
  2. TAWAAZON (IRE)
  3. STEEL MAGNOLIA (IRE)

races.name: Hartes Group Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
Plenty with chances but MILLHONE arrives on the up and is fancied to build on a very good Cork second and gain a first success at the chief expense of Jessica Harrington's new German recruit Wie Wunderbar who could prove handily weighted and is worth monitoring in the betting. Amavasya, Tero D'Rosa and Derry Lad all need factoring into this open handicap too.

  1. MILLHONE (IRE)
  2. WIE WUNDERBAR
  3. AMAVASYA (IRE)

races.name: TRM BIOACTIVE Energy Boost Handicap
races.verdict:
OB LA DI ran a cracker from a less-than-ideal position when second at Leopardstown last month and Johnny Murtagh's mare can notch her third career success dropped back in distance sporting reapplied cheekpieces. Diamond Exchange is only 3 lb higher than when scoring here just under 3 weeks ago, so she's put forward as the main threat, with Alice Monet and stable-switcher Guardian of Realm taken to fight out third.

  1. OB LA DI (IRE)
  2. DIAMOND EXCHANGE (IRE)
  3. ALICE MONET (IRE)

races.name: Blackmore Building Contractors Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict:
SEA OF CHARM arrives in good order after back-to-back seconds behind a thriving rival and is taken to go one better in a much less competitive scenario. Highland Harvey continues in form and ran well over C&D earlier in the year, so rates the main threat.

  1. SEA OF CHARM (FR)
  2. HIGHLAND HARVEY (IRE)
  3. WRIST ART (IRE)

races.name: blackmorebuild.com EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Cases can be made for a few but TREE WIZARD took his form up a notch in first-time blinkers when runner-up at Windsor in June and, having switched yards since, he gets the tentative nod to open his account. Tricky Jenny went within a flared nostril of getting off the mark on penultimate start and she heads up the dangers if able to put a lesser effort behind since. Last Dandelion can fill out third.

  1. TREE WIZARD
  2. TRICKY JENNY
  3. LAST DANDELION

races.name: John Heal Memorial Nursery
races.verdict:
CROWNED looks well treated and may find things setting up perfectly for him to get off the mark. Dreams Galore and Harry's Pop are both last-time-out winners who may have to settle for minor money on this occasion.

  1. CROWNED (IRE)
  2. DREAMS GALORE (IRE)
  3. HARRY'S POP

races.name: Blackmore Equestrian Construction Handicap (Brighton Summer Sprint Series Final)
races.verdict:
The series final can go the way of SECRET HANDSHEIKH, who made it 2 wins from his last 3 starts with a commanding success here earlier in the month. He is taken to land a sixth course victory, with the hat-trick-seeking Arnaz feared most from what remains a workable mark. Twirler and Diomed Spirit complete the shortlist.

  1. SECRET HANDSHEIKH
  2. ARNAZ
  3. TWIRLER

races.name: Blackmore Design & Build Handicap
races.verdict:
KNIGHTS GOLD is on a handy mark and can resume winning ways with Billy Loughnane booked. Sea Suite has maintained his form well this season and should be thereabouts, with Foreseen another to consider.

  1. KNIGHTS GOLD (IRE)
  2. SEA SUITE (IRE)
  3. FORESEEN

races.name: Blackmore Proudly Sponsoring Brighton Racecourse Handicap
races.verdict:
This looks a good opportunity for MY OLD MATE to regain the winning thread. Marsh Benham can give him most to think about if bouncing back from a heavy defeat at Salisbury on Friday.

  1. MY OLD MATE (IRE)
  2. MARSH BENHAM (IRE)
  3. DANEHILL STAR (IRE)

races.name: Neu-Servo Bet On Great Repairs Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A few with chances but it could pay to side with CAMINO ROCIO who was a five-time chase winner for Jim and Suzi Best and now starts out for Dan Skelton on the back of a breathing operation off a reduced mark. Hat-trick seeking Gata Ban rates the obvious threat, with Axel Bleue another fancied to play a prominent role.

  1. CAMINO ROCIO (IRE)
  2. GATA BAN (IRE)
  3. AXEL BLEUE

races.name: Neu-Servo Rapid Response Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Dan Skelton's new recruit AT THE OCHE looked well ahead of his mark when going in at the first time of asking over fences at Uttoxeter and can make light of a 9 lb rise in the weights. Chasing newcomer Little Ledgend comes here in excellent form over hurdles and appeals as the one to chase him home ahead of the consistent Pep Talking.

  1. AT THE OCHE (IRE)
  2. LITTLE LEDGEND (IRE)
  3. PEP TALKING

races.name: Neu-Servo Neigh Bad Repairs Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
THETYPE ISTITLE was a comfortable winner on Rules debut when making all at Stratford in June and she can build on that effort at the second attempt to double her tally. Turbogeist shaped encouragingly when runner-up over C&D on his first start and is feared most, while Delulu is much respected for the Skeltons on debut.

  1. THETYPE ISTITLE (IRE)
  2. TURBOGEIST (IRE)
  3. DELULU

races.name: Neu-Servo Phils Last Shift Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
DOWN TO BUSINESS made a promising start for new connections last season and, having had a breathing operation since prior to this return, Dan Skelton's 4-y-o gets the nod to open his account at the expense of Thiscouldbetheone, who showed more like his hurdling debut form when third at Tramore in the spring and has since switched yards. Network Gold rounds off the shortlist on reappearance.

  1. DOWN TO BUSINESS
  2. THISCOULDBETHEONE (IRE)
  3. NETWORK GOLD

races.name: You Spindle Me Rightround Baby Rightround Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
RAFFLES NOBU looks well worth another chance to build on his decisive Newton Abbot success last month. Graecia could be very dangerous if back on song following a break. Saturday's Newton Abbot winner Playful Fox would have to be feared if turned out again quickly.

  1. RAFFLES NOBU (FR)
  2. GRAECIA (IRE)
  3. PLAYFUL FOX (FR)

races.name: Neu-Servo Best Repairs Hands Down Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
TINTINTIN has fallen a long way in the weights since his fourth in last year's Imperial Cup and could be worth a chance on return. Letterston Lily makes plenty of appeal, with Harry and Dream Diamond other notable dangers in a tricky handicap.

  1. TINTINTIN (FR)
  2. LETTERSTON LILY
  3. HARRY (SWE)

races.name: Neu-Servo Supports Larsen's Pride Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
DIAMOND WHITE should have won when second at Newton Abbot last month and looks capable of going one better now switched to handicap company, with the yard in form and the step up in trip looking sure to suit. Mrs Biddle showed plenty of ability when trained in Ireland and the booking of Harry Cobden catches the eye, while Kylenoe Dancer is also respected.

  1. DIAMOND WHITE (IRE)
  2. MRS BIDDLE (IRE)
  3. KYLENOE DANCER
